one_line: Four historians from different eras whose writings turned the 1857 uprising into a battleground of colonial, nationalist, state and subaltern interpretations.

appearance.age_look: mid-30s, lean and athletic, slightly taller than average
appearance.face: oval face with sharp cheekbones, medium-light brown complexion, straight nose, thin moustache and small goatee, intense thoughtful eyes with a calm, analytical default expression
appearance.hair: short, slightly wavy black hair neatly combed back with a subtle side part, no headwear
appearance.costume: well-fitted mid-20th-century Nehru-style scholar’s outfit: a knee-length closed-front band-collar coat in deep charcoal grey wool (inspired by Delhi academia), simple off-white cotton churidar trousers, plain black leather shoes, and a muted maroon wool stole draped around the neck and hanging evenly in front to echo archival seriousness and political gravity
appearance.signature: a worn tan leather satchel hanging from his left shoulder, half-open to reveal rolled-up documents and a single hardbound book stamped subtly with the numbers “1857” on its spine, held in his right hand like a ready reference

ref_desc: A lean mid-30s scholar with an oval medium-light brown face, short wavy black hair, thin moustache and goatee, in a charcoal Nehru coat, off-white churidar, maroon stole and black shoes, carrying a tan leather satchel and an 1857-marked book.
sheet_prompt: Full-body anime-style character: a lean mid-30s Indian male scholar with an oval medium-light brown face, sharp cheekbones, straight nose, thin moustache and small goatee, and short slightly wavy black hair combed back with a subtle side part, wearing a knee-length charcoal grey Nehru-style coat with band collar and hidden buttons, off-white cotton churidar trousers, and plain black leather shoes; a muted maroon wool stole is neatly draped around his neck, hanging down the front to suggest seriousness and ideological weight. He holds a hardbound book with the number 1857 subtly stamped on the spine in his right hand, and a worn tan leather satchel hangs from his left shoulder, partly open to reveal rolled documents and loose papers, evoking contested archives. Draw him in a neutral, steady stance with a calm, analytical expression, showing the face clearly and the entire costume from head to toe, with colours dominated by charcoal grey, off-white, maroon, black and tan leather, in clean shonen-anime linework suitable for repeated use as a canonical model sheet.
